item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 02/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will cover southeastern China and bring very hot weather to southern China today and tomorrow. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to linger over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the next few days. There will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong. Besides, the area of low pressure now over the seas east of Luzon is bringing unsettled weather to the region. Its subsequent development and movement remain uncertain.
